about_the_game:
Fireteam Breach is a competitive tactical shooter where two teams battle across objective-based game modes such as Secure Area, Bomb, and Hostage. Each round is a test of strategy, coordination, and precision where every wall, window, and hatch can be the difference between victory and defeat.

Destruction is at the heart of the experience. Create new angles of attack, lock down objectives with reinforced defenses, or open up rotations that catch enemies off guard. Maps are designed to evolve every round through the choices players make, ensuring no two matches are ever the same.

Players step into the boots of operators from a newly formed private military company—specialists who broke away to take control of their own missions. Each operator brings unique gadgets and skills, enabling tactical creativity and counterplay. This is about skill, teamwork, and tactical creativity. Attackers and defenders must adapt to one another and master both firepower and positioning to claim the win.

Matches are given an extra layer of unpredictability with a dynamic system that randomizes the time of day and weather. A familiar location might feel completely different at night under rainfall or during a clear midday push, adding variety and replayability to every session.

Unpredictability shapes every match. Power-loss events plunge maps into emergency lighting, forcing teams to adapt mid-round.

Flying drones provide critical recon but must be carefully managed to avoid exposure. And with randomized weather and time of day, familiar maps can feel completely new under night storms or bright midday assaults.

Whether going head-to-head in online multiplayer or practicing against bots, Fireteam Breach is designed to deliver a fair, demanding, and community-driven tactical experience.

Key Features

  • Round-based competitive multiplayer with Attackers vs Defenders

  • Core game modes include Secure Area, Bomb, and Hostage

  • Fully destructible environments that let players create new sightlines and strategies

  • Random time of day and weather conditions for unique matches every session

  • Balanced weapons and gadgets that reward tactical decision-making

  • Competitive play with the option to train against AI-controlled opponents

  • A vision shaped by community feedback to keep the game evolving

content_descriptors.notes:
This game includes gun violence and war-like violence. Including blood, explosions, destruction, screams, and bullet hit reactions. 

The game also includes drug assets placed throughout the environment solely for set dressing purposes.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10, Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 3 1200 @ 3.1 GHz, Intel Core i5-4590 @ 3.3GHz, or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 1060 (6GB), or better
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 60 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX 9.0c compatible sound card with latest drivers
  • VR Support: None
